profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software engineer passionate about building communities for girls and women in tech, AAPI advocacy, and baked goods.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design web applications for Google Cloud Platform storage products.

Activities at Google: Filipino Googler Network Eng Women (Lead), University Recruiting and Outreach, Student Training in Engineering Program (Intern Host & Mentor), Noogler Onboarding (Mentor), Women Teaching Women To Code (Instructor)

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught a seven-week computer science curriculum to 20 high school girls, largely from historically underrepresented communities.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented an open-source command-line tool for container images.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: Designed and engineered an interactive exhibit for Google’s Partner Plex (campus building for VIP stakeholders) to showcase music and dance cultures from across the globe. Exhibit detected user movement to cue YouTube video playback and music visualization animations, across a distributed system of devices.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major in Computer Science, Minor in Cultural Anthropology

projects.title: Kambal
projects.description: Launching and scaling a fundraising initiative that brings the joy of elevated, Asian-themed baking kits to communities across America. Proceeds support AAPI causes.
